enriched_activities.activity: Working a night shift as a part-time aged-care support worker at the residential aged-care facility, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning, hydration and medication reminders, and writing up detailed handover notes for the morning staff
enriched_activities.desc: Walk the corridor. Push the medication trolley to the first room. Knock on the door. Open the door. Turn on the room light. Greet the resident by name. Help the resident sit up in bed. Place both hands under the resident's arms. Reposition the resident onto their side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Fill a cup from the water jug. Hand the cup to the resident. Take the cup back. Place the medication cup on the bedside table. Pick up the medication chart. Read the entry. Tick the box on the chart. Place the chart back on the trolley. Turn off the room light. Close the door. Push the trolley to the next room. Repeat the repositioning, hydration and medication reminder sequence for each resident. Return to the nurses' station. Sit at the desk. Open the handover notebook. Write the time, resident name and care given for each entry. Sign the bottom of each entry. Tear off the completed sheet. Place the handover notes in the morning staff folder.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, checking text messages and reviewing the written shift handover on his phone while travelling
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the work bag. Walk out of the facility. Walk to the train station. Tap the travel card on the reader. Walk onto the platform. Stand behind the yellow line. Board the train. Sit down. Take the phone out of the pocket. Unlock the phone. Open the messaging app. Read the new text messages. Type a short reply. Scroll to the handover document. Read the notes on the screen. Lock the phone. Put the phone back in the pocket. Stand up at the stop. Walk off the train. Tap the card on the reader. Walk to the bus stop. Board the bus. Sit down. Take the phone out again. Re-read the handover notes. Lock the phone. Put the phone away. Stand up. Walk off the bus. Walk to the front door of the house.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light breakfast after the night shift, toasting bread, boiling the kettle for a cup of tea, and quietly putting away his work bag and uniform
enriched_activities.desc: Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door. Put the work bag down on the floor. Take the uniform shirt out of the bag. Hang the shirt on the hook. Open the kitchen cupboard. Take out the bread bag. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Place the slices in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Close the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the bench. Take a tea bag out of the box. Drop the tea bag into the mug. The toaster pops. Take the toast out of the toaster. Place the toast on a plate. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Put the kettle back on its base. Carry the plate and mug to the table. Sit down. Eat the toast. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate. Rinse the mug. Place both on the drying rack. Pick up the work bag. Carry it to the bedroom. Put it down beside the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing up and changing out of his work clothes, then rinsing his uniform in the basin to wash properly later
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Adjust the temperature handle. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and torso. Put the soap down. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the waist. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk to the bedroom. Take off the work trousers. Put on clean trousers. Put on a clean shirt. Pick up the worn uniform trousers. Walk back to the bathroom. Turn on the light. Put the plug in the basin. Turn on the tap. Fill the basin with water. Put the uniform trousers and shirt in the water. Rub the fabric with both hands. Pull the plug out. Let the water drain. Turn off the tap. Wring the uniform out. Hang the uniform on the hook. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Closing the curtains, turning on the fan for steady background noise, setting his phone to silent with a written reminder for the afternoon, and preparing for daytime sleep after the night shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Take hold of the curtain edge. Pull the curtains closed. Walk to the desk. Press the fan switch on. Turn the fan speed dial to low. Pick up the phone. Press the side button. Set the phone to silent mode. Place the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the pen and the notebook. Write the afternoon reminder on the page. Put the pen down. Close the notebook. Place the notebook next to the phone. Pick up the alarm clock. Set the alarm for 15:00. Put the alarm clock back on the bedside table. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the body. Close the eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping during the day after the night shift, keeping the room dark and quiet for recovery
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Remain still under the blanket. Turn from the back onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn onto the right side. Push the pillow into place under the head. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn onto the back again. Push the blanket down to the waist. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket back up. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn onto the stomach briefly. Turn back onto the back. Open the eyes at the alarm. Reach out the right arm. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the side button to check the time. Put the phone back down. Push the blanket off. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Press the fan switch off. Walk to the curtains. Pull the curtains open. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and eating a late flexitarian lunch of rice, lentils and vegetables, reheating it in the microwave and drinking a cup of tea while sitting quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the container of rice, lentils and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Open the microwave door. Place the container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the time button. Press the start button. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the bench. Take a mug out of the cupboard. Place the mug on the bench. Open the drawer. Take out a spoon. Close the drawer. The microwave beeps. Open the microwave door. Take the container out. Tip the contents onto the plate. Place the container in the sink. Fill the kettle with water. Turn the kettle on. The kettle boils. Pour hot water into the mug with a tea bag. Place the kettle back. Carry the plate and mug to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the spoon. Eat the rice, lentils and vegetables. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate, mug and spoon to the sink. Rinse them. Place them on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a load of laundry in the washing machine, including his aged-care uniform, and setting the dehumidifier to help things dry indoors
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Take the uniform trousers and shirt off the hook. Open the washing machine door. Place the uniform into the drum. Walk to the bedroom. Open the laundry basket. Pick up the dirty clothes. Carry them to the bathroom. Place the clothes into the drum. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Close the washing machine door. Press the programme dial to the cotton setting. Press the start button. Walk to the dehumidifier. Plug the dehumidifier into the socket. Press the power button. Press the humidity setting button. Walk to the sink. Pick up the towel. Hang the towel on the rail. Pick up the toiletry bag. Place the toiletry bag on the shelf. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at his desk with the desk lamp on, working through written university readings and notes on the computer for his Master of Social Work coursework
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Adjust the lamp head towards the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse. Open the browser. Open the university reading list page. Click the first reading link. Scroll down the page. Read the text on the screen. Open the notes document. Type headings into the notes file. Type bullet points from the reading. Scroll back up. Re-read a paragraph. Type a summary sentence. Open the second reading link. Scroll through the document. Type more notes. Save the file with the key combination. Close the browser tab. Look at the printed reading sheet on the desk. Pick up the pen. Underline a line on the sheet. Put the pen down. Save the notes file again. Close the laptop lid. Press the desk lamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner in batches, preparing a flexitarian meal with vegetables and tofu in the induction cooker and rice in the rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the tofu, vegetables and rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the ingredients on the bench. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and a chopping board. Close the drawer. Place the chopping board on the bench. Place the tofu block on the board. Cut the tofu into cubes with the knife. Push the tofu cubes into a bowl. Pick up the vegetables. Cut the vegetables into pieces on the board. Push the vegetable pieces into another bowl. Open the cupboard. Take out the rice container. Open the rice container lid. Pour rice into the rice cooker pot. Open the tap. Rinse the rice in the pot. Pour the water out. Add fresh water to the pot. Place the pot into the rice cooker. Close the rice cooker lid. Press the rice cooker switch on. Place the induction cooker on the bench. Plug the induction cooker into the socket. Press the power button. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Add the tofu cubes to the pan. Stir the tofu with a spatula. Add the vegetable pieces. Stir the vegetables. Press the induction cooker power button off. Turn on the range hood. Press the range hood switch off. Place the cooked tofu and vegetables into a bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and drinking tea, then packing a portion into a container in the refrigerator for the next shift
enriched_activities.desc: Open the rice cooker lid. Spoon rice into a bowl. Place the bowl on the table. Carry the bowl of tofu and vegetables to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice, tofu and vegetables. Stand up. Fill the kettle with water. Turn the kettle on. Take a mug out of the cupboard. Place a tea bag in the mug. The kettle boils. Pour hot water into the mug. Place the kettle back on its base. Carry the mug to the table. Sit down. Drink the tea. Stand up. Open the cupboard. Take out a food container. Place the container on the bench. Spoon the remaining rice into the container. Spoon the remaining tofu and vegetables into the container. Press the lid onto the container. Open the refrigerator door. Place the container on the shelf. Close the refrigerator door. Carry the bowl, plate and mug to the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Place them on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning the bench and cooktop, wiping down the appliances he used and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the cloth from the hook. Turn on the tap. Wet the cloth under the water. Turn off the tap. Wipe the bench surface with the cloth. Wipe the chopping board. Rinse the chopping board. Place the chopping board on the rack. Wipe the induction cooker surface with the cloth. Wipe the rice cooker body with the cloth. Wipe the microwave door with the cloth. Wipe the kettle body with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the bottom rack. Pick up the plates from the sink. Place the plates in the rack. Pick up the bowls. Place the bowls in the rack. Pick up the chopsticks. Place the chopsticks in the basket. Pick up the cooking pot. Place the pot on the top rack. Push the bottom rack in. Push the top rack in. Add detergent to the dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Moving the laundry to the clothes dryer, folding the dried washing in the bathroom and tidying his towel and toiletries
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the washing machine door. Take the wet clothes out of the drum. Place the clothes into the clothes dryer drum. Close the washing machine door. Close the clothes dryer door. Press the clothes dryer power button. Press the programme button. Press the start button. Open the cupboard. Take out the dried washing. Place the dried washing on the bench top. Pick up a shirt. Fold the shirt. Place the folded shirt on the pile. Pick up trousers. Fold the trousers. Place them on the pile. Pick up a towel. Fold the towel. Place the towel on the rail. The dryer stops. Open the clothes dryer door. Take the uniform out of the dryer. Fold the uniform. Place the folded uniform on the pile. Pick up the towel from the rail. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toiletry bag. Open the toiletry bag. Check the toothbrush and toothpaste inside. Close the toiletry bag. Place the toiletry bag on the shelf. Press the dehumidifier power button off. Unplug the dehumidifier. Carry the folded washing out of the bathroom to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Place the folded clothes on the shelf. Close the wardrobe door. Walk back to the bathroom. Turn off the bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Tracking his weekly budget in a written notebook, counting out cash for the week's shared bills and confirming upcoming rent and utility amounts
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the desk drawer. Take out the budget notebook. Close the drawer. Open the notebook to the current week page. Pick up the pen. Write the date at the top of the page. Write the grocery amount on the line. Write the transport amount on the line. Write the placement travel amount on the line. Add the column of figures with the pen. Write the total at the bottom. Open the desk drawer. Take out the cash envelope. Open the envelope. Take the notes out. Count the notes onto the desk one by one. Count the coins from the coin purse. Write the cash total in the notebook. Write the share of the shared bills on the next line. Open the phone. Open the banking app. Read the rent amount on the screen. Write the rent amount in the notebook. Read the utility amount on the screen. Write the utility amount in the notebook. Lock the phone. Put the cash back into the envelope. Seal the envelope. Place the envelope in the drawer. Close the drawer. Close the notebook. Put the notebook on the desk. Put the pen down. Press the desk lamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Drafting a written agenda for the next house meeting and typing detailed text-only messages to confirm quiet hours and shared plans in advance
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the notebook. Open it to a blank page. Pick up the pen. Write the heading 'House meeting agenda' at the top. Write '1. Quiet hours' on the next line. Write '2. Shared bills' on the next line. Write '3. Cleaning rota' on the next line. Write '4. Kitchen appliance use' on the next line. Put the pen down. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Open the messaging app. Click the group chat. Type a message about quiet hours after 22:00. Press the send key. Type a message about the bin rota. Press the send key. Type a message about the shared bill amount. Press the send key. Read the replies on the screen. Type a reply confirming the meeting time. Press the send key. Type a message about the laundry machine booking. Press the send key. Close the messaging app. Save the agenda file on the computer. Close the laptop lid. Pick up the pen. Close the notebook. Place the notebook on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for a last cup of tea and preparing a simple breakfast and snack to take to tomorrow's placement
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Close the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the bench. Take a tea bag out of the box. Drop the tea bag into the mug. Open the cupboard. Take out a lunch box. Place the lunch box on the bench. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Take two slices of bread out of the bag. Place the slices into the lunch box. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the cheese. Close the refrigerator door. Place the cheese into the lunch box. Close the lunch box lid. Place the lunch box on the bench. The kettle boils. Pour hot water into the mug. Place the kettle back on its base. Pick up the fruit bowl. Take an apple out of the bowl. Place the apple next to the lunch box. Open the cupboard. Take out a muesli bar. Place the muesli bar next to the apple. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Place the mug in the sink. Rinse the mug. Place the mug on the drying rack. Pick up the lunch box, apple and muesli bar. Carry them to Bedroom 1. Place them in the work bag. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening washing routine, brushing his teeth and taking a warm shower before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Open the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Close the cap. Put the toothpaste tube down. Brush the teeth. Fill a cup with water. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Wipe the mouth with a towel. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the temperature handle. Step into the shower. Wet the body and hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Put the soap down. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the waist. Wipe the floor with the mat. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Looking at a saved photo of his family dog in China on his phone, reading a few pages of a book and winding down under the fan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedside lamp. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the side button. Unlock the phone. Open the photo gallery. Scroll to the saved photo of the family dog. Look at the photo on the screen. Zoom in on the photo with two fingers. Zoom back out. Lock the phone. Put the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book to the bookmark. Lie down on the bed. Read the pages. Turn the page. Read the next page. Turn the page again. Read another page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Pick up the bookmark. Place the bookmark inside the book. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Press the fan switch on. Turn the fan speed dial to low. Walk back to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the body.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, having set his written reminders and alarm for the next day's shift and study tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the pen from the bedside table. Open the notebook. Write the reminder for the morning shift on the page. Write the reminder for the study task on the next line. Close the notebook. Put the pen down on the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the side button. Open the alarm settings. Set the alarm time for the morning shift. Press the save button. Check the silent mode is on. Lock the phone. Put the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the alarm clock. Check the alarm time is set. Put the alarm clock back on the bedside table. Reach over and press the bedside lamp switch off. Lie down flat on the back. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn onto the left side. Close the eyes. Remain still under the blanket until the end of the hour.
